image_depicts: Elevated/aerial view of Al-Ahliyya Amman University's campus entrance, main academic building, and grounds, with directional signage and surrounding hills, Amman, Jordan
notes: Uploaded by the university's own Commons account (AmmanU Ahliyya), geotagged to Amman.
review_notes: PROBLEM FOUND: the current image_url ('Al_Ahliyya_Amman_University_22_.jpg') is a real photo, correctly licensed (CC BY-SA 2.0, confirmed via license page, uploaded by the university's own 'AmmanU Ahliyya' Flickr/Commons account), and does genuinely depict this institution -- an Arabic banner in the photo explicitly reads 'Al-Ahliyya Amman University celebrates the graduation of its 22nd batch'. However the photo itself is an INDOOR GRADUATION CEREMONY CROWD SHOT (rows of seated dignitaries in academic robes, an audience of capped graduates, stage decor) -- it shows zero campus architecture and is not a usable representative campus/building photo. This is the same defect category the original researcher itself used to reject other DB photos in this same dataset (Massey University's ice-cream/lifestyle photo, Rice University's mascot photo: 'not a campus photo'), so by the project's own established standard this should not have been marked VERIFIED as a clean representative image despite passing the literal real/correct/no-logo/license checks. REPLACEMENT SOURCED: found and verified 'Al_Ahliyya_Amman_University_Gate.jpg' in the same Commons category (commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Al-Ahliyya_Amman_University) -- a real elevated/aerial photo of the university's actual campus entrance, main building, and grounds with directional signage, hills in the background. License page confirms dual GFDL + CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported, author Jolover93 (2010). Substituting this as the record's image.
